scope: Finite one-execution, one-resource pressure-control fence abstraction

unsafe_control.failure: Safety invariant violation after a pause action is issued, pressure recovers, and the weakened final fence applies the old pause

limits: The model is an abstraction and is not a refinement of production Go.
Fresh pressure and recovery evidence are inputs; native elapsed-clock sampling and hysteresis arithmetic are outside this model.
Native process identity, effect ownership, message delivery, multi-resource recovery, and actual pause/resume remain unaccepted.
Reconcile and FinishAndSettle assume positive external cleanup/settlement; native joins are not modeled.

independent_review.unsafe_trace_checked: Low, Warn, Warn, IssuePause, Recover, ApplyPause; Safety becomes false only at the unfenced effect.
independent_review.tlc_jar_hash_observed: Independent after-run check; a full before/after Java/toolchain closure was not retained.
independent_review.source_only_followup: README semantics and this normalized record were amended after the original run; model and configurations are unchanged.
